How Can You Prepare Before Your Exterior House Painting Estimate?
Preparing for an estimate doesn’t require major effort. A few simple steps help you get more accurate recommendations and make better use of consultation time.

Gathering inspiration photos or preferred color ideas
Listing questions about timeline or materials
Identifying any maintenance concerns noticed during the year
